title: Adaptive Estimation and Inference in Conditional Moment Models via the Discrepancy Principle
abstract: arXiv:2603.01337v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study adaptive estimation and inference in linear inverse problems defined by conditional moment restrictions. These problems are typically ill-posed, so estimators require regularization, yet the optimal regularization strength depends on a source parameter that is almost never known. We develop a discrepancy principle that chooses this parameter from empirical losses and prescribed bounds on statistical error, without knowing the source parameter. The framework covers Regularized DeepIV (RDIV) and the Tikhonov Regularized Adversarial Estimator (TRAE). Under the stated realizability conditions and comparable fitting and calibration error bounds, both one-step procedures attain strong- and weak-error bounds that match known-source rates for source parameters up to one. translated_title: 基于差异原理的条件矩模型自适应估计与推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究由条件矩限制定义的线性逆问题中的自适应估计与推断。这些问题通常是病态的，因此估计器需要正则化，然而最优正则化强度取决于一个几乎从不知晓的源参数。我们开发了一种差异原理，可以从经验损失和预先设定的统计误差界限中选择该参数，而无需知道源参数。该框架涵盖了正则化DeepIV（RDIV）和Tikhonov正则化对抗估计器（TRAE）。在所述可实现性条件以及可比的拟合和校准误差界限下，两种单步程序都获得了强误差和弱误差界限，在源参数不超过1的情况下与已知源参数时的收敛率相匹配。我们还将该框架扩展到在总体迭代可实现性条件下的迭代程序，拓宽了收敛率所能涵盖的源参数范围。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于差异原理的自适应方法，无需知晓未知的源参数即可在条件矩模型的线性逆问题中自动选择正则化强度，使RDIV和TRAE等估计器达到与已知源参数时相同的误差收敛率。
